bobby.description: bobby-browser MCP (stdio gateway, managed Chromium for repeatability). Runs the default explore toolset — the standard form loop needs no toolset_select.

raw-playwright.description: No agent tooling: bash + the playwright library only
raw-playwright.promptSuffix: You have no browser tools. Drive the browser by writing Node scripts that import the 'playwright' package (it is installed in {{harnessDir}}; run scripts with node from that directory, e.g. chromium.launch()) and running them with the Bash tool.
